note: This file contains only data structures (lists and dicts) defining question-flow trees for an annotation tool. No functions, classes, or callable APIs are present. No CLI-usable code exists to invoke via argparse or similar.
LOCATION_RADIO: data structure defining location-related question options for annotation flows
REF_OBJECT_OPTIONALS: data structure defining optional reference object attribute questions (material, color, size, dimensions)
Q_ACTION: data structure defining the main action-type question tree (BUILD, MOVE, SPAWN, DESTROY, DIG, FILL, TAG, STOP, RESUME, UNDO, ANSWER, COMPOSITE_ACTION, NOOP)
REPEAT_DIR: data structure defining direction options for repeated actions (forward, backward, left, right, up, down, around)
Q_ACTION_LOOP: data structure defining loop/repetition question options (once, ntimes, repeat_all, forever, repeat_until)
